say:2:1041313001:1.text: Lorsan, I envy you for being able to travel throughout Esperia. Since I became a teacher, I've never left Vaduso.
say:2:1041313001:1.source_cn: 洛桑，真羡慕你能在伊索米亚各地游历。自从当了老师，我就...

say:3:1041313002:1.text: I can't leave this place, but it would be nice if there was a way for me to appreciate the scenery of other places...
say:3:1041313002:1.source_cn: 我不奢望能像你那样自由出行，但如果有办法能让我领略各地...

say:4:1041313003:1.text: Don't look at me with that sad expression on your face... Alright, I'll remember to send you souvenirs from all the places I visit.
say:4:1041313003:1.source_cn: 别用那种哀怨的眼神看着我……好吧，好吧，我会记得给你寄...

say:5:1041313004:1.text: That's a deal! Remember, every time you go to a new place, you have to send me their local specialty!
say:5:1041313004:1.source_cn: 好呀~就这么说定了！记住，每到一个新地方，都要给我寄一...

say:6:1041313005:1.text: Wait! Why do I feel you deliberately tricked me into this arrangement?!
say:6:1041313005:1.source_cn: 嗯、嗯……等等，我怎么觉得你是故意骗我答应你的？！
